Can a museum change how Bihar sees itself — and how the rest of India sees the state?
Spread across 13 acres in Patna, the Bihar Museum was built at a cost of nearly Rs 500 crore to showcase the state’s rich cultural and historical legacy. From the Didarganj Yakshi to the rise of ancient empires, its galleries tell a story of Bihar’s past.
But its narrative also raises questions about the history it leaves out, including post-Independence caste conflicts and political violence.
